from_wardrobe.name: Breezy folk sundress
from_wardrobe.why: The strappy sundress lets air through in the humidity, and the folk floral print suits a playful afternoon.
from_wardrobe.styling_tip: Add a woven tote and tie your hair up to keep cool.

from_wardrobe.name: Olive and cream utility
from_wardrobe.why: The loose cream cargos let air move, and the fitted olive polo balances their volume.
from_wardrobe.styling_tip: Tuck the polo in fully so the cargos' waist shows.

from_wardrobe.name: Lilac and denim
from_wardrobe.why: Lilac against mid-blue denim looks light and fun, and the sheer shrug adds colour without heat.
from_wardrobe.styling_tip: Let the shrug hang open and roll its sleeves once.

worth_looking_for.description: Boxy short-sleeve camp-collar shirt in breathable linen-cotton with a coral abstract print.
worth_looking_for.search_query: coral print camp collar linen shirt
worth_looking_for.why: A short-sleeve layer you can wear open over the Lilac crop top when the Light blue embroidered shirt is too warm.

worth_looking_for.description: Flowy tiered midi skirt in terracotta cotton voile with an elastic waist.
worth_looking_for.why: It turns your sleeveless tops into several more hot-weather outfits.
